person_note: The diagnostic event passages repeatedly use sustained third-person limited and free-indirect narration centered on Michelangelo, while the authorized interior excerpt and scholarly whole-book analysis independently confirm that structure. All visible first-person forms belong to dialogue or an imagined quotation, and apparent second-person forms are dialogue or generic maxims. Clipped and very short passages were marked unclear or unmarked rather than allowed to vote. No research indicated an epistolary frame or alternating-person sections; the only material limitation is that the authorized excerpt covers one interior episode, which is offset by the whole-book scholarly evidence.
